arxiv.title: DynaWeave: Learning to Adapt through Dynamic Scenario Synthesis
arxiv.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use tools to complete tasks in stateful environments. arxiv.title: Human Interventions as Labels: Localizing, Steering, and (Sometimes) Editing the Computations Behind LLM Agent Failures
arxiv.summary: When an LLM agent misbehaves, a human steps in, and that intervention is usually discarded or replayed as training data. We treat it instead as a measurement: a label pointing at the internal computation that failed. arxiv.title: Think Once, Reflect Twice: How Feedback Shapes Human-AI Collaboration
arxiv.summary: As artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly supports human decision-making in high-stakes domains, designing effective human-AI collaboration becomes critical. Successful collaboration requires humans to reflect on decision-making processes and adjust their strategies accordingly.
